entry_sequence.transcript_quote: once I have a daily bias or Direction I will use this checklist
entry_sequence.action: After establishing higher-timeframe bias or direction, use the checklist to qualify the trade.
entry_sequence.rationale: The checklist is only used after the trader already has directional bias.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: the first thing I focus on is a stop raid
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a stop raid or liquidity sweep first.
entry_sequence.rationale: The setup starts with liquidity being raided before entry is considered.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: the next thing I look for is a market structure shift or displacement
entry_sequence.action: Then wait for a market structure shift or displacement in the intended direction.
entry_sequence.rationale: The shift confirms the post-sweep move is expanding away with intent.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I generally like to see price move back into a discount of this price range here
entry_sequence.action: For longs, wait for price to retrace into discount or OTE of the displacement range; for shorts, wait for price to retrace into premium or OTE of the displacement range.
entry_sequence.rationale: The retrace zone is where the trader wants to re-enter after displacement.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I prefer to have a fair value gut or an order block but I will also use an OTE in this area as well as a breaker block
entry_sequence.action: Use a PD array in that retrace zone, preferably a fair value gap or order block, but a breaker block or OTE can also be used.
entry_sequence.rationale: The PD array is the actual entry location inside the retrace area.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I like to blend one two or three of these Concepts together for my personal strategy
entry_sequence.action: Prefer entries where two or three of the concepts overlap rather than using only one in isolation.
entry_sequence.rationale: The trader's edge comes from combining multiple concepts into one entry area.

stop.rationale: The stop is placed beyond the relevant swing low for longs, and the examples also show using the order block boundary on shorts.

strategies.stop_management: optionally move stop to break even after partials.

targets.transcript_quote: looking for buy side liquidity up here
targets.rationale: Primary target is opposing liquidity such as buy-side liquidity above for longs or sell-side liquidity below for shorts.

targets.transcript_quote: target the initial highs from the morning
targets.rationale: A further target can be prior session highs such as the morning highs.

strategies.name: box_setup_deviation_retest

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we get a move below this range and then back into the range
entry_sequence.action: Define the setup when price deviates outside the range and then reclaims back into it; for long, deviate below the range and reclaim back inside, and for short, deviate above the range and reclaim back inside.
entry_sequence.rationale: The deviation back into the range marks the manipulation phase of the box setup.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: aggress it down aggressive up this is the deviation from the range
entry_sequence.action: Use the aggressive move away from the deviation as confirmation of the reclaim; for long, aggressive down then aggressive up, and for short, aggressive up then aggressive down.
entry_sequence.rationale: The aggressive return suggests rejection of the deviation.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: accumulation manipulation I want to see distribution
entry_sequence.action: Frame the trade as a box setup sequence of accumulation, manipulation, then distribution before entry.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker uses this sequence to define the setup logic.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: ideally I'm looking for a retest of this manipulation
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a retest of the manipulation/deviation area before entering; for long, retest the lower deviation area, and for short, retest the upper deviation area.
entry_sequence.rationale: The retest gives the actual entry location after the reclaim.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: be reaching for the other side here
entry_sequence.action: Enter on the retest for a move toward the opposite side of the range; for long, target the upper side, and for short, target the lower side.
entry_sequence.rationale: The box setup aims for expansion across the range to the opposite side.

stop.rationale: The speaker does not state a structural initial stop for this scoped box setup segment.

strategies.stop_management: Take partials as price moves toward the opposite side and the example shows the possibility of moving the stop to break even after partials.

targets.transcript_quote: be reaching for the other side here
